reported_issue: Jumping hands and arm gestures look unnatural.
original_cause: Fixed character-space hand heights sit near or above the shoulders on Timmy, whose head is large and torso is short. Wrist orientation was inherited from the base animation.
implementation: Use evaluated shoulders and actual arm lengths for low, softly bent jump targets.
Vary the arm position through takeoff, descent and landing.
Derive wrist axes from the actual knuckles and align fingers with the forearm.
Blend the jump contribution down during bow aiming, retain throw priority, and leave the carrying right arm to the carry solver.
iterations: A first fixed-height lowering still failed the independent shoulder-clearance check.
A proportional pose passed but looked cupped in front of the abdomen; reduced forward reach and lowered hands to the sides.
Final 76-check focused run passed, and front, side, behind, carrying, bow and throw captures were inspected.
historical_reference: docs/qa/v0.11.0/00-jump-rising.png shows the previous raised-hand pose. Historical environment artwork differs; compare the pose only.
limits: Procedural adjustment of the existing Mixamo character; no new imported jump clip or independent human playtest.
